summary: Ollama is a self-hosted LLM server + desktop app that persists local model manifests/blobs as files under ~/.ollama/models/, a SQLite chat/settings/user store (desktop app), and CLI integration config in ~/.ollama/config.json.

_no_edges.why: public POST /api/blobs/:digest with no auth, no preconditions, calls nothing (server/routes.go:1707)
POST /api/v1/settings; no database-backed precondition or wall (token cookie only, ui.go:1534)
POST /api/v1/cloud writes server.json; no precondition, no credential check in the handler (app/store/cloud_config.go:52)
CLI-launch config write; no precondition, no auth (cmd/config/config.go:133)
CLI config write; no precondition, no auth (cmd/config/config.go:166)

runtime_notes: No login: ollama's API has no account/password — auth is an opaque launcher token cookie, not a database identity. Every tool is intentionally anon (requires_auth:false). All preserved model/chat/cloud tools are single-owner, so they are genuinely global with no scope declared.
